report: All three sisters are engaged and aligned on next steps. C raised the concern about A buying the house at a family discount. A says she has no firm price yet and agrees to an independent valuation. B would prefer to sell her share, hoping to fund a small dance studio. Everyone has agreed to two first steps: confirm the exact wording of the will regarding the house, and obtain an independent valuation. No price has been discussed, and C has not agreed to any discount. The process is at an early stage, with the valuation and will review pending before any price negotiation begins.
